scientific_conclusion: The three fixed common-frame heat-flux moments reconstruct the exact Stage-77 face field and cell divergence to numerical precision. The transverse-kinetic contribution is the only preregistered dominant moment, supplying 55.9233% of the componentwise cell-divergence absolute magnitude and 53.9415% of the face absolute magnitude, while its adjacent-x-face correlation is 0.918724, above the retained 0.90 coherence guard. The streamwise-kinetic and reduced-internal contributions supply 23.9438% and 20.1330%, respectively. Intercomponent cancellation is negligible at this level (cell ratio 0.999761; face ratio approximately 1), while each moment remains strongly face-to-cell cancellation dominated. This is a positive localization result for residual structure, not validation and not evidence that changing transport or quadrature will improve q_av.
positive_findings: Moment-gradient closure is at machine precision against the exact Stage-77 artifact.
The transverse-kinetic moment exceeds the preregistered 50% dominance guard and remains coherent across adjacent x faces.
No cavity solver rerun or physical/numerical retuning was performed.
negative_findings: The attribution is not an adjoint sensitivity and does not establish that modifying any solver term would reduce the benchmark heat-flux error.
The failed Stage-28 MUSCL endpoint remains unrecovered and is not extended across Knudsen number.
